mapper.sql: id, target_type AS targetType, target_id AS targetId, page_type AS pageType, template, create_time AS createTime
mapper.insert: insert into fly_template_assign (target_type, target_id, page_type, template, create_time) values (#{assign.targetType}, #{assign.targetId}, #{assign.pageType}, #{assign.template}, now()) on duplicate key update template = #{assign.template}, create_time = now()
mapper.select: select from fly_template_assign where target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId} and page_type = #{pageType} limit 1
mapper.delete: delete from fly_template_assign where target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId} and page_type = #{pageType}
mapper.select: select from fly_template_assign where target_type = #{targetType} order by create_time desc
